target.definition: Area load = vehicles on roads upstream of the signal (back to the previous signal or the map edge) plus vehicles waiting to enter there, plus 0.5 x the same for directly connected controlled signals. Target = minus the discounted sum, over the next 16 five-second ticks (discount 0.95), of the change in area load since the decision.

sensing.observes: Local, plus receiving roads to the next signal, the signals feeding each approach (their queues, greens and recent departures), vehicles further upstream than 250 m, and queues one and two controlled signals away.
sensing.measurement: Exact per-lane counts, stopped counts, speeds and positions from the simulator. Not roadside-sensor measurements.
